text_block_list.text: Since Hokko Tarumae wasn't feeling well, I decided to let her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry...
I'll make sure to get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why am I here...?
I thought I was in the nurse's office...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, have you tried that haskap berry drink from the shop in front of the station?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Down the hatch!
It's rich, but goes down so smoothly, right~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is that Tomakomai salmon...?
And over there is a Tomakomai surf clam fair!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: W-What is happening...?

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text:
Man, when you want a hearty meal,
nothing beats Tomakomai's curry ramen!

text_block_list.name: Passerby D
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Tomakomai really is the place to be these days!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Could this mean...
an unprecedented Tomakomai boom is coming...?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: But why...? Were they featured on TV or something...?

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text: Huh, could you be—

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text:
The driving force behind the Tomakomai boom!
Could it be Hokko Tarumae?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby E
text_block_list.text:
It really is! I'm a huge fan!
Um, could I have your autograph?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (No, this is no time to be bewildered... In front of the fans, there's only one thing to do!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: You caught me! Okay, I'll sign autographs, so line up, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text: Yeeees!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: All right, time to put my all into writing this!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
? ...Ah, it was a dream.
Of course...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...No, this isn't just a dream, I really have to make it a nationwide trend someday!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: All right, let's get fired up and do our best!

Afterward, whether because she had a good dream or not,
Hokko Tarumae's condition
got much better.

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text: Oh, so that's not it? Bummer...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
N-No...! That's not what I meant!
Please wait...! No, hang on a sec!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A dream, huh... Still,
why did dream-me have to be so flustered...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: When things turn out like that, you have to switch gears right away, but... *sigh*

Perhaps having had an unpleasant dream,
Hokko Tarumae's condition
did not recover...
